description: @testing-library/user-event under Jest's modern fake timers (T11.11): userEvent.setup({ advanceTimers: jest.advanceTimersByTime }), await user.click and user.type with a delay, and waitFor from @testing-library/dom, which finds Jest's fake clock by typeof jest and setTimeout.clock and advances it while it polls. A waitFor that never matches times out on the fake clock with its DOM dump. Two files on one worker.
